notes: Receivable grants of a group (AR_TRNSTYPE_PASSWORD, AR_CUSTOMER_PASSWORD ranges, AR_CUST_PASSWORD customers and AR_SALESMAN_PASSWORD salesmen of the SE version of the form; read by APP_RULES_AR / SA / APP_PROC_AR); all types / customers / salesmen and select all / none buttons (APP_RULES3_SE, see processes/ARPASS.md)

params.name: FLAG
params.lov_sql: select case when app_sec.lang = 'en' then e else a end d, r from (select 'إختيار الكل' a, 'Select all' e, 1 r from dual union all select 'استبعاد الكل', 'Deselect all', 0 from dual) order by r desc

params.name: MAINAREA
params.lov_sql: select d.id || ' - ' || case when app_sec.lang = 'en' then nvl(d.name_e, d.name_a) else d.name_a end d, d.id r from ar_mainarea d order by d.id

params.name: SUBAREA
params.lov_sql: select d.id || ' - ' || case when app_sec.lang = 'en' then nvl(d.name_e, d.name_a) else d.name_a end d, d.id r from ar_subarea d order by d.id

params.name: CTGRY
params.lov_sql: select category_type_code || ' - ' || case when app_sec.lang = 'en' then nvl(category_type_desce, category_type_desca) else category_type_desca end d, category_type_code r from st_category_type order by category_type_code

params.name: SALESMAN
params.lov_sql: select code || ' - ' || case when app_sec.lang = 'en' then nvl(name_e, name_a) else name_a end d, code r from salesman order by code

params.name: SUBAREA
params.lov_sql: select d.id || ' - ' || case when app_sec.lang = 'en' then nvl(d.name_e, d.name_a) else d.name_a end d, d.id r from ar_subarea d order by d.id
